title: Dress for the Weather
description: Short-haired breeds need extra protection from cold. Consider sweaters or coats for outdoor activities.

title: Protect Those Paws
description: Ice, snow, and salt can damage paw pads. Use paw balm and consider booties for walks.

title: Stay Hydrated
description: Pets can dehydrate in winter too! Ensure fresh water is always available.

title: Warm Shelter
description: Keep indoor temperatures comfortable and provide cozy sleeping areas away from drafts.
